research.interpretation: Priorities reflect observed search intent and portfolio fit, not measured demand, ranking difficulty, or a growth trend.
research.snapshotLocation: Dated source snapshots and the full research summary are preserved in this chat's visualization directory under serper-consulting-2026-10-17.

queryGroups.intentObserved: Mostly application implementation and service-provider results, with educational content mixed in.
queryGroups.scope: Hands-on product integration using existing models, retrieval, backend workflows, representative evaluations, and handover.

queryGroups.intentObserved: Technical consulting, architecture, and deployment providers, with private-model and hardware expectations mixed in.
queryGroups.scope: Application infrastructure around model calls: queues, workers, retries, workload isolation, provider limits, observability, and deployment. Not GPU-fleet management or foundation-model training.

queryGroups.intentObserved: Predominantly guides, playbooks, and comparisons; dedicated service offers also appear.
queryGroups.publicationGate: Use a cost-and-latency baseline and output-quality checks. Publish quantified savings only when an original workload-specific comparison supports them.

queryGroups.intentObserved: Commercial deployment services, often emphasizing private or on-premise model hosting.
queryGroups.scope: Application deployment and production integration. Do not imply specialist GPU inference hosting.

queryGroups.intentObserved: Mixed consulting brands, careers, hiring, and role-definition content.
queryGroups.scope: Retain applied AI engineering as the expertise description, paired with specific LLM application work and evidence.

siteConstraints: Contact is the single inquiry destination. Its fragment anchors are not separate canonical landing pages.
Keep the Applied AI engineering and Scalable AI infrastructure labels, existing anchors, and topic-specific email drafts.
Do not restore separate Consulting navigation, a homepage sales section, or near-duplicate synonym pages.
Use a quiet, curious, concrete personal voice. Preserve published result attribution and workload boundaries.
Keep HTML, Markdown twins, visible headings, structured data, and descriptive inquiry links aligned.
publicationGate: An existing engineering problem or original project evidence must justify the content; a trend or product release alone is not demand validation.
Use dated primary sources for external technical claims. Search suggestions and competitor page counts are not search-volume measurements.
Do not relabel 100K+ backend requests as model calls, a 50% generation-time improvement as LLM cost savings, or deployment-speed improvements as inference benchmarks.
Prefer improving an existing useful article or case study to publishing a thin landing page.
Check built HTML, Markdown parity, internal anchors, inquiry behavior, and narrow-screen layout before handoff.
Record a production release date only after a deployment is verified. Local edits and passing tests are not proof of publication.
